name: Small Furry Paws
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.offerRewardText:
Great, you got them! We can use these to make toys and baubles, and those will attract more people to the Faire!

Here's your ticket, adventurer. You earned it!
narrative.requestItemsText:
The first lesson in drawing a crowd is: lure them with gadgets and trinkets! Can you help me?

I need small furry paws to use for prizes. You can find those on the cats of the Barrens or Darkshore....

Bring me some paws and I'll trade you a Darkmoon Faire ticket for them.
